description: Conflict analysis for project-scoped template filtering - validates compatibility with related specifications and identifies integration risks

synergies.description: Project-scoped filtering extends org-scoped filtering. Both specifications target multi-tenant isolation. Project filtering adds the final layer (global → org → project).
synergies.integration: Project-scoped filtering COMPLETES the multi-tenant hierarchy. No conflicts - additive enhancement.
synergies.benefit: Achieves finest-granularity isolation (project-level) while maintaining org-level and global visibility

synergies.description: Project-scoped filtering adds filtering logic to template queries. SurrealDB-primary caching defines storage architecture. Both work on same files but different aspects (filtering vs caching).
synergies.integration: Filtering happens at SurrealDB query level (WHERE clause). Caching happens at storage level (cache-aside pattern). Completely orthogonal concerns.
synergies.benefit: Filtered queries benefit from cache performance, cached results are pre-filtered

changes.project-scoped-filtering: Added project_id parameter (optional, default=None). Removed TODO skip logic for project-scoped templates (lines 185-191). Extended filtering condition.
changes.surrealdb-primary-redis-cache: Cache-aside pattern: Redis check → miss → SurrealDB query → cache populate
changes.thompson-sampling: Expected value calculation for variant selection

sharedComponents.analysis: All changes are additive and orthogonal. Function signature extended (backward compatible). Filtering logic enhanced (org + project). Caching pattern unchanged. Thompson sampling uses filtered results.
sharedComponents.recommendation: Continue monitoring. All specifications integrate cleanly.

changes.project-scoped-filtering: Added project_id parameter. Extended SurrealDB WHERE clause: OR (scope='project' AND project_id=$project_id)
changes.activity-template-query-filtering: Implemented org_id WHERE clause: OR (scope='org' AND org_id=$org_id)
changes.surrealdb-primary-redis-cache: Called on cache miss to query SurrealDB (source of truth)

sharedComponents.analysis: SurrealDB WHERE clause progressively extended: global → org → project. All filtering conditions are additive (OR logic). Cache-aside pattern defines when to query, filtering defines what to return.
sharedComponents.recommendation: Query complexity increased but remains efficient. Consider SurrealDB index on (scope, org_id, project_id).

changes.project-scoped-filtering: Added org_id and project_id fields (Optional[str], default=None)

potentialIssues.description: activity-template-query-filtering validation found that API responses don't include scope and org_id fields. Project-scoped filtering adds project_id field, which may also be missing from responses.
potentialIssues.rootCause: Template creation response doesn't serialize scope, org_id, and project_id fields. SurrealDB stores them correctly, but HTTP response filters them out.
potentialIssues.evidence: activity-template-query-filtering test case 1 FAILED: response.scope = null, response.org_id = null. Database logs show fields ARE stored.
potentialIssues.impact: LOW - Filtering works correctly (database layer). Observability affected (clients cannot verify scope assignment).
potentialIssues.recommendation: Investigate response serialization path. Check: (1) Pydantic response model schema, (2) FastAPI serializer configuration, (3) JSON encoder filtering None values.
potentialIssues.action: Add scope, org_id, project_id to response model or ensure template dict includes them in serialization.

potentialIssues.description: activity-template-query-filtering test case 3 FAILED: User 1 cannot see their own org-scoped template. This was BEFORE project-scoped filtering implementation.
potentialIssues.rootCause: Unknown. Possible causes: (1) Scope field missing in response breaks template matching, (2) org_id mismatch, (3) Filtering logic too restrictive.
potentialIssues.evidence: Test case 3: user1CanSeeOwnTemplate = false (expected true). Impact: HIGH
potentialIssues.impact: HIGH - If users cannot see their own templates, multi-tenant isolation is too strict and breaks functionality.
potentialIssues.recommendation: Re-run activity-template-query-filtering harness after project-scoped changes. Verify filtering logic at lines 185-195 handles None values correctly.
potentialIssues.action: Run validation: ts-node tests/validation-harnesses/activity-template-query-filtering-harness.ts. Debug if test case 3 still fails.

content.summary: Project-Scoped Template Filtering Implementation is FULLY COMPATIBLE with all related specifications. Zero conflicts detected. All specifications work together synergistically: multi-tenant isolation (project + org filtering) + SurrealDB-primary caching + Thompson sampling. Main risks: (1) Response serialization missing new fields (medium, non-blocking), (2) Inherited user visibility issue from org-scoped filtering (high, requires verification).
